name: interaction-park-resume
description: Rich Interactions, the happy path. A session that DECLARED the `identity_form` render capability in `supports` gets the real card: the agent's server-registered `request_identity_intake` raise tool PARKS the turn and the server emits `interaction_required` (kind `identity_intake`, a server-minted `interactionId`, the canonical `spec.fields`, and the agent's `reason`). A matching `submit_interaction` — same requestId, same interactionId — acks 200 and RESUMES the parked turn, which streams the wrap-up reply. The raise tools are server-registered in every server, so this needs no `server.*` directive; only the mock names the tool. ⚠️ The park event is asserted BEFORE the raise tool's `stream_chunk`, matching the Rust reference and the same ordering the corpus already pins for write-confirmation HITL (`hitl-write-confirmation`). Go / TypeScript / Python / .NET emit the chunk first; see the README's divergence note.
